address.title: Website address
address.redirectNote: Visitors who open {{host}} are sent to your custom domain. Both addresses keep working.
address.subdomainUntilVerified: Your custom domain becomes the primary address as soon as Atlas verifies it. Until then your Atlas subdomain is the address to share.
address.subdomainOnly: This is the address to share. Connect a custom domain below to use your own.
address.subdomainUntilHttps: Your custom domain is verified. It becomes the primary address as soon as its certificate is active and Atlas confirms it answers over HTTPS. Until then your Atlas subdomain is the address to share.
address.subdomainWhileBroken: Your custom domain is not serving visitors right now, so your Atlas subdomain is the address to share until it is fixed.

subdomain.title: Atlas subdomain
subdomain.help: Atlas provides this address automatically, manages its HTTPS certificate, and keeps it working even if a custom domain is disconnected.
subdomain.notConfigured: Atlas's platform domain isn't configured yet, so a subdomain address isn't available for your website. This will appear automatically once it is.

custom.title: Custom domain
custom.empty: You haven't connected a custom domain yet. Use your own address, like www.your-academy.com.
custom.added: Domain connection started — add the DNS records below
custom.addError: Failed to start connecting this domain
custom.hostnameHelp: Enter the exact address you want visitors to use, without https://. A subdomain such as learn.your-academy.com is recommended.
custom.removeConfirmDescription: Your website will fall back to its Atlas subdomain. This can be reconnected later.

checked.configure_dns: Checked — DNS records are still missing
checked.verifying: Checked — still verifying, DNS changes can take a while to propagate
checked.blocked: Checked — Atlas still can't register this domain with its provider
checked.securing: Checked — verified; waiting for the certificate and HTTPS
checked.https_failed: Checked — verified, but HTTPS is not working yet

custom.dnsInstructionsHelp: Add these records at the company that manages your domain's DNS. Atlas re-checks automatically every few minutes; you can also check now at any time.
custom.cnameTargetUnavailable: Atlas is not ready to route custom domains yet, so the CNAME target isn't available. Your Atlas subdomain keeps working; please try again later or contact support.
custom.dnsRecordsPending: Verification records will appear here once the domain is registered with Atlas's infrastructure provider.

stepHelp.connect: Enter the domain you want to use.
stepHelp.configure_dns: Add the DNS records below at your DNS provider, then check.
stepHelp.verifying: Atlas's infrastructure provider is validating your DNS. This usually takes minutes, sometimes up to a day.
stepHelp.live: Your domain is verified, Atlas's certificate is active, and Atlas confirmed it serves your website over HTTPS.
stepHelp.attention: Something stopped this domain from working. Review the details below, fix the DNS records if needed, then check again.
stepHelp.blocked: Atlas could not register this domain with its infrastructure provider yet, so there is nothing for you to configure. This is on Atlas's side — Atlas retries automatically every few minutes; you can also try again now or change the domain.
stepHelp.securing: Your domain is verified and registered at the edge. Atlas is now waiting for the HTTPS certificate to be issued and for the address to answer securely — this usually takes minutes. Keep the DNS records below in place; the certificate validation record is required.
stepHelp.https_failed: Your domain is verified, but visitors cannot load it over HTTPS yet. Review the reason below. Atlas re-checks automatically every few minutes; you can also check now.
stepHelp.live_certificate_pending: Your domain is verified and Atlas confirmed it serves your website over HTTPS. Atlas's own certificate for it has not been issued yet, so HTTPS currently depends on your own DNS provider's proxy. Add the certificate validation records below so Atlas can issue its certificate.

custom.changeHelp: Enter the address you want instead. The domain you entered before will be released and its verification progress discarded.
custom.changeLiveConfirmDescription: {{hostname}} is live and serving your website. Replacing it disconnects it immediately; visitors are served on your Atlas subdomain until the new domain is verified and secured.
custom.changed: Domain changed — add the DNS records below

addErrors.hostnameTaken: This domain is already connected to another academy. If it is yours, disconnect it there first or contact support.
addErrors.hostnameReserved: This address belongs to the Atlas platform and can't be used as a custom domain. Use a domain you own, like learn.your-academy.com.
addErrors.invalidHostname: Enter a valid domain, like learn.your-academy.com.
addErrors.forbidden: You don't have permission to change this academy's domain.
addErrors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.

provider_unavailable.title: Atlas couldn't reach its infrastructure provider
provider_unavailable.description: Nothing changed on your side. Atlas will retry automatically; you can also check again in a few minutes.

provider_hostname_missing.title: Atlas re-registered this domain with its provider
provider_hostname_missing.description: The provider had lost this domain, so Atlas registered it again. Keep the DNS records below in place; verification restarts automatically.

provider_error.title: The last check failed
provider_error.description: The infrastructure provider didn't answer. Atlas will retry automatically; you can also check again in a few minutes.

dns_not_pointing.title: Your DNS doesn't point to Atlas yet
dns_not_pointing.description: Make sure the CNAME record below exists exactly as shown. DNS changes can take up to a day to propagate.

provider_registration_failed.title: Atlas's provider refused to register this domain
provider_registration_failed.description: This is an Atlas-side configuration problem, not something at your DNS provider. Atlas retries automatically every few minutes; you can also try again now. If it persists, contact support.

infrastructure.title: HTTPS & infrastructure
infrastructure.subdomainHttpsManaged: Managed by Atlas with a platform-wide certificate.
infrastructure.httpsNotProbed: Atlas checks HTTPS once the domain is connected.
infrastructure.httpsPendingProbe: Atlas has not confirmed HTTPS on this address yet. Check now to run the check.

provider_not_registered.title: Atlas could not register this domain yet
provider_not_registered.description: Atlas's infrastructure provider has not accepted the domain, so there are no DNS records to add. Nothing is wrong with your domain or your DNS. Atlas keeps retrying automatically; if this persists, contact support — the Atlas team can see the exact provider reason.

routing_target_missing.title: Atlas is not ready to route custom domains
routing_target_missing.description: The domain is registered, but Atlas's platform has no routing target for custom domains yet, so a CNAME record can't be given. Your Atlas subdomain keeps working. Atlas retries automatically; contact support if this persists.

origin_error.title: The address answers, but with an error ({{code}})
origin_error.description: The edge reached your domain but could not complete the connection to Atlas's servers (HTTP {{code}}). This is on Atlas's side — nothing to change at your DNS provider. Atlas re-checks automatically; you can also check now.

tls_or_connection_failed.title: The secure connection could not be established
tls_or_connection_failed.description: The HTTPS handshake to your domain failed. This usually clears once the certificate is issued; keep the DNS records below in place.

timeout.title: The address did not answer in time
timeout.description: No answer arrived within the check's time limit. Atlas re-checks automatically.

unresolvable.title: The domain does not resolve
unresolvable.description: Public DNS returned no address for this domain. Make sure the CNAME record below exists exactly as shown.

non_public_address.title: The domain points to a private address
non_public_address.description: This domain resolves to an address Atlas does not check for security reasons. Point it at the CNAME target below.
non_public_address.short: Points to a private address — checked {{time}}

ip_literal.title: IP addresses cannot be checked
ip_literal.description: Use a hostname, not an IP address.

certificate_failed.title: The certificate could not be issued
certificate_failed.description: The provider could not validate the certificate for this domain. Make sure the certificate validation record below exists exactly as shown, then check again.

certificate_expired.title: The certificate has expired
certificate_expired.description: The provider reports an expired certificate. Make sure the validation record below is still in place so it can be renewed, then check again.

unknown.title: HTTPS is not working yet
unknown.description: Atlas could not confirm HTTPS on this address. Atlas re-checks automatically; you can also check now.

certificatePending.title: Your site is live, but Atlas's certificate is still pending
certificatePending.description: Visitors reach your website securely today because your DNS provider's proxy serves its own certificate. Atlas's infrastructure provider has not been able to validate Atlas's own certificate yet — the TXT records it needs are not the ones currently published. Add the certificate validation records below exactly as shown; Atlas re-checks automatically.

validation.tooShort: Enter the domain you want to use.
validation.invalid: Enter a valid domain, like learn.your-academy.com (no https://, no path).

platformDomain.title: Domains
platformDomain.subtitle: How every Academy website is addressed, whether custom domains are verified, and whether the infrastructure behind them is ready.
platformDomain.baseDomainHelp: Every Academy is reachable at its own slug under {{baseDomain}} — for example harvard.{{baseDomain}} — and can add a custom domain on top.
platformDomain.managedByEnvironment: Set by the deployment (PLATFORM_BASE_DOMAIN). It drives routing, the wildcard certificate and DNS, so it isn't editable here — change the deployment to change it.
platformDomain.databaseFallbackHelp: This deployment has no PLATFORM_BASE_DOMAIN set, so the value stored here is used to build Academy addresses. It performs no DNS or certificate setup by itself.
platformDomain.error: Failed to save the platform domain
platformDomain.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes to the platform domain.

readiness.title: Infrastructure readiness
readiness.providerNotConnected: Cloudflare API credentials are missing or invalid
readiness.customHostnamesReady: Custom domains can be routed — a fallback origin is active
readiness.customHostnamesNotReady: Custom domains cannot be routed yet — no active fallback origin on the zone
readiness.originSslCompatible: Origin SSL mode works with the platform's origin certificate
readiness.originSslIncompatible: Origin SSL mode is misconfigured — "strict" rejects the origin certificate for custom domains
readiness.originSslUnknown: Origin SSL mode could not be read
readiness.platformHttpsReachable: The platform domain answers over HTTPS
readiness.platformHttpsUnreachable: The platform domain does not answer over HTTPS
readiness.wildcardUnreachable: Academy subdomains do not answer over HTTPS
readiness.checkedAt: Checked {{time}} — every line is a live answer from the provider or a live probe.
readiness.providerRefused: Provider refused the zone read — code {{code}} ({{category}})

categories.not_enabled: feature not enabled on the zone

originSslState.permission_missing: Origin SSL mode is not exposed to Atlas — the API token lacks "Zone Settings: Read"
originSslState.provider_error: Origin SSL mode could not be read — the provider did not answer
originSslState.unavailable: Origin SSL mode could not be read — no valid provider credentials

readiness.originSslPermissionDetail: Provider code {{code}}. Add "Zone Settings: Read" to the token to have Atlas verify the mode; the value is not guessed.
readiness.sweepStale: The verification sweep has not completed recently
readiness.sweepNever: The verification sweep has never completed
readiness.releasesClear: No provider resources are waiting to be released
readiness.releasesPending: Provider resources are waiting to be released
readiness.releasesPendingDetail: {{count}} pending — retried automatically until the provider confirms
